fix: expose the linked pull request on the agent issue read (#544)

A reviewer could not tell a linked fix from an unlinked one. `issueSelect`
returned `proofLinks` but not `pullRequestUrl`, so the only way to learn
whether `POST /issues/{id}/test-results` would answer `409 no_pull_request`

and `intake`, including the warning that `proofLinks` is not the fix link.

The head SHA is included because a verdict records the commit it tested, so a
reviewer needs to see which commit a verdict would bind to.

commits.message:
fix(ENDOR-556): give heartbeats their own rate budget

A claim's 15-minute silence clock requires a heartbeat at least that
often, which previously spent the same 30-writes/hour budget as real
work (create, comment, bid, validate, test-verdict). An agent that
used its write budget on real work could lose an active claim as
"silent" simply for being unable to afford the heartbeat that would
have kept it.

Add a dedicated `heartbeat` budget kind (120/hr, standard and burst)
alongside `read` and `write`, wire `POST /api/v1/issues/{id}/heartbeat`
to charge it instead of `write` via `agentIssueRequest`'s existing
`options.budget` mechanism, and document the new budget in
docs/ziki-for-agents.md (table + llms.txt doc-matching test).

Tests: lib/agents/rate-budget.test.ts (new counter is independent of
write/read, has its own 120/hr cap), lib/agents/rate-budget.docs.test.ts
(docs match the code), app/api/v1/issues/[id]/heartbeat/route.test.ts
(new — heartbeat succeeds with write budget exhausted, is charged to
`heartbeat` not `write`, honestly 429s once heartbeat's own cap is hit).

fix(483): ignore IME composition keys in assignee combobox (#1205)

Enter and the arrow keys belong to the IME while a candidate is being composed. The assignee combobox handled them anyway, so pressing Enter to confirm a Japanese/Chinese/Korean candidate picked the highlighted person and closed the list (#483).

Return early from the key handler while nativeEvent.isComposing is true or the browser reports keyCode 229, matching the mention picker. Add jsdom coverage for composing Enter (both signals), arrows during composition, and normal selection once composition ends.

fix: cap attachment uploads while streaming, not only by Content-Length (#485) (#1207)

* fix(485): cap attachment bodies while streaming, not only by Content-Length

POST /api/v1/attachments (and /api/uploads) trusted Content-Length: a chunked request declares none, so the 5 MB pre-check saw 0 (or NaN) and request.formData() buffered the whole body before checkAttachment ran.

readLimitedMultipart now streams the body itself, stops as soon as it passes the cap, and cancels the rest. A declared length over the cap is still refused without reading; a non-numeric or negative Content-Length is a 400.

* test(485): assert the guard reads nothing on a fast reject

Use highWaterMark: 0 so the test stream never prefetches; a single pull now proves the body was read. Fast-reject cases assert zero pulls (CodeRabbit).
